name: USD/CAD SMA Crossover - Fixed Units 1H
description: SMA crossover strategy on USD/CAD using 20, 50, 200-period SMAs on 1H bars. Long when 20 crosses above 50 or 200, short when crossing below. Position sizing: 300,000 units for 20×50 crosses, 600,000 units for 20×200 crosses. Exit at 100 pips profit OR 50 pips stop loss.
source:
# USD/CAD SMA Crossover Strategy
# Long/Short entries on SMA crossovers with fixed unit sizing
# 20x50 crosses = 300,000 units, 20x200 crosses = 600,000 units
# Take profit: 100 pips (0.01), Stop loss: 50 pips (0.005)

# Data source - 1H bars
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1H)()
close = src.c

# Calculate SMAs
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# Entry signals - crossover/crossunder
# 20x50 crossover/crossunder signals
long_20x50 = crossover(sma_20, sma_50)
short_20x50 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_50)

# 20x200 crossover/crossunder signals
long_20x200 = crossover(sma_20, sma_200)
short_20x200 = crossunder(sma_20, sma_200)

# Combined entry signals
long_entry = long_20x50 or long_20x200
short_entry = short_20x50 or short_20x200

# Position sizing based on which cross triggered
# 300,000 for 20x50, 600,000 for 20x200
# When both signals occur, take the larger size (20x200)
long_size = 600000 if long_20x200 else (300000 if long_20x50 else 0)
short_size = 600000 if short_20x200 else (300000 if short_20x50 else 0)

# Determine position size (positive for long, negative for short)
position_units = long_size if long_entry else (-short_size if short_entry else 0)

# Entry/exit zone logic
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry)

# Position sizing with unit type
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=abs(position_units))

# Stop loss: 50 pips = 0.005 price movement
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.pips)(distance=50)

# Take profit: 100 pips = 0.01 price movement
take_profit(unit=StopUnit.pips)(distance=100)

# Visualization - SMA lines
timeseries_lines(
    title="SMA Crossover Signals",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 20", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 200", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(sma_20, sma_50, sma_200)
